title: Context-aware Fairness Evaluation and Mitigation in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring political-ideological inclination in isolated, single-turn prompts using the multilingual Political Compass Test (PCT), eliciting agree/disagree responses to 62 ideological statements.

bias_targets.target: Demographic bias (Gender, Race, Age, Religion, Disability, Appearance)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating implicit stereotypes and explicit toxicity in multi-turn conversational settings using the FairMT-Bench dataset, scored via an LLM-as-a-judge ensemble (GPT-3.5-Turbo, Claude, and Llama Guard) to track bias accumulation.

Qualitatively analyzing generated responses for ethnocentric or essentialist generalizations regarding ancient versus modern societies, assessing how mitigation softens these into pluralistic perspectives.
